input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives both Parties a convenience exit on ninety (90) days' notice against a one-year auto-renewing term, which sits at the fallback on notice period (60–90 days) and on HDI's side (effectively end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days' notice) — neither is flagged. The material failure is the price of our exit: Section 4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment on the Company alone equal to 50% of the preceding twelve months' Net Sales over $800,000, which is uncapped and many multiples of three months' fees (fees are 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month), and by its terms bites on any Company termination other than the Section 1.6 launch failure. That exceeds the fallback's cap of an early-termination fee not greater than three months' fees and renders our convenience right illusory. Because the rest of the termination architecture is already at the fallback and HDI carries build/programming cost against a revenue share, we have made the proportionate edit rule guidance contemplates — capping the payment at three months' fees and confirming it is not payable where we terminate for HDI's failure to launch or breach — rather than deleting it outright. The eight-quarter payment schedule in 4.2(c) is unaffected.

proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and confirm no payment on termination for HDI's failure or breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook allows an early-termination fee of no more than three months' fees, so we have capped the Termination Payment accordingly and confirmed it is not payable if we exit for HDI's failure to launch or breach. As drafted the payment is half of a full year's Net Sales above $800,000, which is many multiples of the fees and would make our 90-day exit right unusable.

ops.oldText: the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided, that (i) in no event shall the Termination Payment exceed an amount equal to three (3) months' fees, calculated using the average monthly fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 during the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date, and (ii) no Termination Payment shall be due if the Company terminates this Agreement pursuant to Section 1.6 or as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement.
